name: Matbench Discovery balanced unrelaxed-structure qualification v1
population: All released unique_prototype=True rows with finite e_above_hull_mp2020_corrected_ppd_mp and uniquely aligned valid ordered initial periodic structure. No chemistry, size, near-hull or model-support exclusions.

sampling.algorithm: Python random.Random(seed).sample over lexicographically sorted material IDs, stable then unstable, without replacement
sampling.weights: Source-distribution estimates require population stratum counts /50. Primary balanced accuracy only.

target: DFT-relaxed MP2020 corrected signed distance <=0 eV/atom against fixed MP DFT hull. No predicted hull or clipping.
input: Initial lattice species fractional coordinates PBC only; opaque ID; MP-only reference allowed. No WBM energies or target metadata.
tool: CHGNet checkpoint0.3.0 already MP2020-corrected total energy/atom minus fixed MP DFT hull total energy/atom after relaxation. No double correction. Pin dependencies/checkpoint/reference before production.
answer: Strict JSON exactly one boolean stable field; reject duplicates extras nonboolean symlink nonregular oversized missing output.
metrics: Balanced cohort accuracy; both constant baselines50%. Not leaderboard, source raw accuracy, or evidence of scientific skill from10-70% gate.
dependence: Stratified random structures, not independent groups. Replaces earlier unfrozen grouping proposal to avoid nonuniform selection and unavailable lineage. Unique prototypes do not imply independence; conditional descriptive CI only.
failures: Keep all100. No replacements. At most one infrastructure-only retry of same task; report first attempt separately.
audit: Key-free independent reconstruction from WBM CSE historical MP2020 and MP-only hull. Freeze judgments before gold comparison. Assess correct/opposite booleans against reconstructed sign. Scientific disagreements separate from parser tests; unavailable reconstruction means unmeasured not zero.
security: No gold/source summary in build context; verifier and oracle mounted only after agent. Qualification requires network dataset retrieval blocked and isolation validated. Public memorization risk remains.
scope: Balanced finite adaptation, not official benchmark. Licensing uncertainty excluded. No workbook edits.
